option_relations.rationale: Atrial Tachycardia is a broad category of supraventricular tachycardias originating in the atria, distinct from AVRT.
Atypical AVNRT is a specific type of AVNRT, which is a reentrant tachycardia involving the AV node, distinct from AVRT.
Focal atrial tachycardia is a type of atrial tachycardia originating from a single focus in the atria, distinct from AVRT.
AV nodal reentrant tachycardia (AVNRT) is a reentrant tachycardia involving the AV node, distinct from Orthodromic Atrioventricular Reentrant Tachycardia (OAVRT) which involves an accessory pathway.
